data.name: Tool_SendNotification_Description

data.name: Tool_WebSearch_AiDescription
data.value: Search the internet and return the titles, URLs and content snippets of relevant web pages.

data.name: Tool_FetchUrl_AiDescription
data.value: Fetch a URL and extract its main text, for reading the details of a searched page.

data.name: Tool_ReadClipboard_AiDescription
data.value: Read the text content of the system clipboard.

data.name: Tool_Powershell_AiDescription
data.value: Run read-only PowerShell commands (read-only verb allowlist + write-operation blocklist; confirmation required before each run).

data.name: Tool_SearchFiles_AiDescription
data.value: Search files by name, optionally within a directory (e.g. Desktop). Prefers the Windows Search index, falling back to a directory scan.

data.name: Tool_ReadFile_AiDescription
data.value: Read file contents. Text/code files are read directly; PDF, Word, Excel, PPT, HTML and similar documents are automatically converted to Markdown via MarkItDown. For large text files, use keyword search or start_line/end_line segments; do not use PowerShell just to read file contents.

data.name: Tool_WriteFile_AiDescription
data.value: Write a text file inside the configured output directory (create/overwrite/append); executable and binary types are blocked.

data.name: Tool_FileOpen_AiDescription
data.value: Open a file or folder, or launch an application, using the Windows default program.

data.name: Tool_CodeExecute_AiDescription
data.value: Run Python code in a separate process (best-effort sandbox, not fully secure; 10s timeout, 100 KB output limit).

data.name: Tool_Git_AiDescription
data.value: Run Git operations in a repository: read-only status/diff/log/show/branch/rev-parse, plus add/commit which require confirmation.

data.name: Tool_FileTree_AiDescription
data.value: Get the file tree of a directory (with depth and entry-count limits).

data.name: Tool_DiarySearch_AiDescription
data.value: Keyword search across past diary entries. Use when the user asks "what did I do before", "what did we talk about last week", or "that day". Returns matching dates and content excerpts for recalling past conversations.

data.name: Tool_TurnSearch_AiDescription
data.value: Keyword search across past conversation-turn summaries. Use when the user mentions a specific event, file or decision but isn't sure which day. Returns matching turn summaries and their dates, finer-grained than the diary.

data.name: Tool_AddTask_AiDescription
data.value: Create a task, optionally with a due time and reminder time (local time).

data.name: Tool_ListTasks_AiDescription
data.value: List tasks, optionally filtered by status (pending/done/cancelled/all).

data.name: Tool_CompleteTask_AiDescription
data.value: Mark the specified task as completed.

data.name: Tool_RememberFact_AiDescription
data.value: Remember a long-term fact about the user for later recall. The key must be an English phrase with underscores (e.g. preferred_language, editor_theme); the value is a natural-language description. Do not record secrets such as passwords or API keys.

data.name: Tool_ForgetFact_AiDescription
data.value: Forget (delete) a previously remembered long-term fact; the fact's key is required.

data.name: Tool_ListFacts_AiDescription
data.value: List remembered long-term facts, optionally filtered by keyword. Use to see what is currently remembered about the user.

data.name: Tool_Fs_NoExtension
data.value: The file has no extension and was rejected by the safety policy.

data.name: Tool_Fs_TooLarge
data.value: File too large ({0} KB); the limit is {1} KB.

data.name: Tool_AddTask_Param_DueAt
data.value: Due time (ISO 8601 or yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm, local time); optional

data.name: Tool_CodeExecute_Param_Code
data.value: Python code to run (Python only). Best-effort sandbox: networking and file-system access are blocked (regex blocklist for import socket/urllib/requests, open(), os./shutil/pathlib/subprocess, etc.).

data.name: Tool_FetchUrl_Param_Url
data.value: Full URL of the page to read (must start with http:// or https://)

data.name: Tool_FetchUrl_Msg_Timeout
data.value: Fetch timed out or was cancelled.

data.name: Tool_FileOpen_Param_Path
data.value: Path to a file, folder or application. Supports aliases like desktop/documents/downloads/pictures/music/videos/home

data.name: Tool_FileOpen_Msg_NotFound

data.name: Tool_ForgetFact_Param_Key
data.value: Key of the fact to forget

data.name: Tool_ForgetFact_Msg_NotFound
data.value: No fact with key "{0}" was found.

data.value: Extra arguments passed to the subcommand, e.g. ["--stat"], ["HEAD~3"], ["newfile.txt"]

data.name: Tool_Git_Param_Path

data.value: Optional; filter by keyword in key or value

data.value: Filter status: pending / done / cancelled / all; default pending

data.name: Tool_Powershell_Param_Command
data.value: Read-only PowerShell command to run. Pipes are allowed, but each segment must start with Get/Test/Select/Where/Measure/Format/Group/Sort/Compare/ConvertTo/ConvertFrom/Out-, and must not contain write verbs such as Remove/Set/New/Invoke/Start/Stop/Restart/Install/Uninstall/Enable/Disable/Clear/Add/Out-File/Set-Content/Remove-Item.

data.value: The command contains an empty pipe segment.

data.name: Tool_Powershell_Msg_BadVerb
data.value: Command not allowed: every pipe segment must start with a read-only verb (Get/Test/Select/Where/Measure/Format/Group/Sort/Compare/ConvertTo/ConvertFrom/Out-). Offending segment: {0}

data.value: Command not allowed: it contains a forbidden write verb. Offending segment: {0}

data.name: Tool_ReadFile_Param_Path
data.value: Path of the file to read. Relative paths are based on the working directory; supports text/code files plus PDF, Word, Excel, PPT, HTML and similar documents.

data.value: Optional: search for a keyword (case-insensitive) and return matching lines with context. Prefer this for large files.

data.name: Tool_ReadFile_Param_StartLine

data.name: Tool_ReadFile_Param_EndLine
data.value: Optional: inclusive end line; up to 120 lines are read when omitted.
